title: Horten twin-jet flying wing, rear view of engines (Fig. 2)
description: Photograph, printed sideways, of a Horten flying wing aircraft seen from the rear, showing the two jet engine exhausts in the centre section, weathered wing panels and landing gear. Photo number "34918 A.C." along the edge and captioned "Fig. 2" below. Part of a report comparing tailless aircraft to reported flying disks.
